  -  Signed informed consent obtained from both parents
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Birthweight  [OR] ≥ 1500 g and/or gestation age ≥ 32 weeks
  -  Lack of informed consent of the parents
  -  Congenital heart defect, other than PDA  [OR] and/or patent foramen ovale (PFO)
  -  The presence of a clinically apparent hemorrhagic syndrome
  -  Any intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) in the first 48 hours or IVH  [OR] grade 3-4
  -  A platelet count of < 50,000/mm3
  -  A serum creatinine concentration of > 110 μmol/L
  -  Oliguria <1 ml/kg/h
  -  Suspected/ [OR] apparent NEC
  -  Suspected/ [OR] apparent lung hypoplasia
